g.text: One menu. Every recon tool you need. Zero flag-memorizing.
Created by rxvy · Version 3.0 · Open Source
rxvy-recon wraps well-known recon, OSINT, and
security-testing tools behind one fast terminal menu.
Traffic routes through ProxyChains by default, and every
tool is one number-and-target away — no flags to memorize.
Built for CTFs, homelabs, and authorized pentest engagements.
Educational use, CTFs, security research, and authorized
testing only. Only run these tools against systems you own
or have explicit permission to test. Unauthorized scanning
is illegal in most jurisdictions. The author is not
responsible for any misuse of this software.
[*] Star the repo if rxvy-recon is useful to your workflow.
